topic: MCP stdio entrypoint layout and startup order
summary: src/index.ts bootstraps process (loadConfiguration then startServer); src/server.ts owns McpServer + serveStdio. Empty tools list is valid.
details: Issue #49 / branch j1-t9/server-entrypoint. index.ts: await loadConfiguration(process.env), then dynamic import startServer. server.ts startServer is import-time pure until called; constructs McpServer with capabilities.tools {} and serveStdio. Do not serve before config succeeds; do not treat empty tools/list as failure.

topic: Process startup stderr and exit gates
summary: ConfigError → one formatConfigErrorLine stderr line and exit 1; non-ConfigError (D5) → fixed line xq-jewy: internal error and exit 1.
details: index.ts failFromUnknown routes ConfigError through formatConfigErrorLine; all other throws/uncaughtException/unhandledRejection emit INTERNAL_ERROR_LINE (xq-jewy: internal error). Empty stdout on failure. Do not invent alternate D5 wording or multi-line config stderr.

summary: N-CI-03 is ungated: Inspector CLI with -e XQ_JEWY_CONFIG=<absolute path>; tools/list may be empty.
details: CI runs npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli node dist/index.js -e XQ_JEWY_CONFIG=$CFG for initialize and tools/list. Pass absolute config via Inspector -e, not process env alone. Empty tools list is an accepted success signal for the smoke.

summary: XQ_JEWY_TEST_INJECT_REJECTION=1 is a test-only hook for D5 (N-SYS-06), not a product feature.
details: When set to 1, index.ts intentionally Promise.reject then returns so unhandledRejection exercises the D5 gate (fixed stderr, exit 1). Keep it out of docs/product surfaces; use only for N-SYS-06-style system tests.

summary: #49 lands MCP stdio entrypoint on j1-t9/server-entrypoint: loadConfiguration then serveStdio, ConfigError/D5 gates, ungated N-CI-03.
details: Adds src/server.ts; rewires src/index.ts for config-then-serve and error gates; system tests N-SYS/N-ACC/N-CI-07; CI Inspector smoke mandatory with -e XQ_JEWY_CONFIG. Depends on #47 loadConfiguration and F2 ConfigError shape already on base.
